final_wiki.answer-Q-1995-X8E:
Q-1995: What day of the week was 2022-03-05?
Answer: Saturday

Calculation: 2022-03-05. Using Zeller's formula or known reference: 2022-01-01 was Saturday. Jan has 31 days, Feb 2022 has 28 days (not leap). Days from Jan 1 to Mar 5: 31 + 28 + 4 = 63 days after Jan 1. 63 mod 7 = 0, so same weekday as Jan 1 = Saturday.
(A55)
